candidates.path_text: "The master policy number is AGB-2024-TC-GROUP." -> The master policy number AGB-2024-TC-GROUP determines when coverage terminates upon policy termination. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the Master Policy terminates." -> If coverage ends due to reasons other than non-payment, the individual may convert to an individual policy. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege."
